work.name: Safety Knights
highlights: Built an internal CRM using TypeScript, JavaScript, React (Next.js), HTML/CSS and PostgreSQL that replaced 5 separate sales and marketing tools, giving a 3-person team one login instead of five.
Developed a no-code automation engine with REST APIs and webhooks that lets non-engineers build their own sales workflows, cutting ~12 hrs/week of manual CSV exports and data re-entry.
Integrated the Instantly and Apollo REST APIs to automatically find and merge duplicate leads and keep both tools in sync, so sales reps never contact the same person twice.
Set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Docker that runs 1,000+ automated tests and deploys in about 5 minutes, and moved hosting to DigitalOcean for predictable, fixed monthly costs.

Used Claude Code with agentic workflows (parallel sub-agents, custom skills and MCP tooling) to plan, build and test features faster, shipping the CRM, automation engine and CI/CD pipeline as a solo developer.

work.name: SUNY Research Foundation, CUBS Lab (Prof. Srirangaraj Setlur)
highlights: Built an automated data pipeline in Python and SQL, deployed on OpenShift (Kubernetes), that collects grant listings from multiple federal and non-federal sources so researchers do not have to search each site by hand.
Added an AI (LLM) parser alongside site-specific parsers so new grant sources can be added quickly, with a self-throttling 10-worker design that avoids overloading source websites.
Closed a security gap in a Python (Flask) API by moving it behind university single sign-on (SAML), so only authenticated users can reach grant data.
Made the Python pipeline fault-tolerant, with bounded work queues so a slow or failing source site does not stall the other nine workers or lose collected data.

work.name: Safety Knights
highlights: Built an EHS job board with JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Angular and MongoDB (NoSQL) behind 75+ REST API endpoints, now serving 4,000+  users.

Split the platform into 3 independently deployable apps (Node.js API, Angular consumer site with server-side rendering, admin console) and encrypted stored data with AES-256, so each part can ship and scale on its own.
Designed a database with location-based search and automatic hourly job expiry so candidates only see open jobs near them.
Built the candidate application flow (document upload, 5-stage status tracking, 3 automated emails) so employers can review applicants in one place.

work.name: CarWale [CarTrade Tech]
highlights: Maintained a shared library of 70+ React and React Native UI components in TypeScript and JavaScript, used across a site with 80M monthly users, cutting bundle size 10% on key pages.
Led a dark theme for 60+ React Native components using React Context, letting users switch themes instantly without reloading.
Used AI coding tools to cut a two-week migration across 250+ files to 2 days.

projects.name: Vantage
projects.description: Self-hosted TypeScript web analytics library with pluggable queue/store adapters and a client tracker (github.com/AdityaSawant0912/vantage)
highlights: Built an open-source TypeScript web analytics library that works with Redis or PostgreSQL, so teams can track site traffic on their own servers without paying for a third-party tool.
Built a browser tracker that sends data reliably, even offline, and counts only the time visitors actively view a page, so engagement numbers are accurate.

projects.name: Optimus
projects.description: Zero-dependency TypeScript feature flag engine with React, Angular & SSR adapters (github.com/AdityaSawant0912/optimus)
highlights: Built and published an open-source TypeScript feature-flag library on npm, with React and Angular support, so teams can turn features on or off for users without redeploying.
Added server-side rendering support so pages load with the right features already switched on, and each user sees the same version on every server.
